experiments: E1 lane training: 8 inner hide-and-recover bags + 43 leakage canaries
E2 arm/budget sweep on the shared holdout (4 arms x 6 budgets)
E3 instrument calibration: all 13 registry rasters x 3 instrument variants
experiment_budget.overrun_note: Wall-clock budget exceeded (~3.6 h vs 2 h). Recorded, not hidden: E3 was a diagnostic forced by an unexplained inversion, and re-running it is what makes the negative result trustworthy.

hypothesis: Unmapped expert-labelled faults are physical discontinuities measurable in the 19 provided bands. A pixel classifier trained on inner-hidden mapped fault segments (never the segment being predicted) ranks fault-like pixels above background; the off-catalogue part of that ranking, thinned to a 1-px skeleton at a fixed dot budget, is a legal submission.
mechanism: Bagged HistGradientBoosting on 38 shared rank layers (per-band quantile q and 9x9 local-contrast z) plus 5 visible-only catalogue layers (dcat_vis, log1p_dcat_vis, dtip_vis, cdens5_vis, cdens15_vis); 3 bags for the released file, belief averaged, then skeleton thinning to the budget with a 2-px catalogue collar so no dot sits on a mapped fault pixel.
non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted lithologic contacts, dykes and intrusive edges, alluvial-fan and terrace margins, survey flight-line striping, and hydrothermal alteration halos all produce the same local-contrast signature. The flight-line repeatability veto (H4) could not be run - its host is unreachable from this sandbox - so this mimic is NOT excluded.

emission.values: binary 1.0 on the support, exact 0.0 everywhere else (all finite, no NoData)
emission.why_binary: DTI is strictly increasing in a dot's value p whenever that dot carries kernel credit k > 0, and strictly decreasing when k = 0, so the optimum is binary support at p = 1 with every redundant dot omitted (derivation in research/findings.md). A continuous 1-px ridge is the DTI-optimal shape for linear truth: spacing s > 1 along the ridge trades coverage - which the beta = 0.8 false-negative term prices heavily - for a small saving on the alpha = 0.2 false-positive term. The measured arm comparison agrees: thinning beat unthinned top-N at every budget on every instrument.

bootstrap.caveat: Conditional on fitted folds, catalogue labels and fixed budgets; not a leaderboard interval.

holdout_dti.fold_local_note: These arms are fold-local models that never see the withheld segments, so they are NOT inflated by the privileged-catalogue bias that invalidates cross-family comparison on this instrument.

leakage_canary.status: 43/43 single-feature canaries pass (two-sided AUC below the 0.90 leakage bar)
leakage_canary.irregularity: 60,964 of 60,988 catalogue pixels are component tips, so dtip_vis is near-degenerate with dcat_vis; reported, not suppressed.

instrument_validity.finding: The shared hide-and-recover holdout is anti-predictive of organiser-adjacent outcomes for rasters built with the full catalogue.
instrument_validity.decisive_counterexample: GEMSDOE32 (B2) is GEMSDOE25 with every dot within 2 px of the mapped catalogue removed. User-reported leaderboard: 0.2600 -> 0.2778 (pruning HELPED). On this instrument the same pruning collapses pooled DTI 0.0919 -> 0.0037 (coverage 0.142 -> 0.005), i.e. 96% of the proxy credit came from dots hugging the mapped catalogue. The instrument's ranking of these two files is the inverse of the organiser-reported ranking.
known_bias: PRIVILEGED-CATALOGUE BIAS: registry rasters were built with the FULL mapped catalogue, and the proxy truth is a random 20% subset of that same catalogue, so catalogue-hugging dots score as direct hits here. The live truth is disjoint from the catalogue, so those dots are false positives there. This makes cross-family comparison on this instrument invalid.

SHELL BIAS: the shared split forces withheld truth to lie >=3.16 px from visible catalogue, so proxy truth piles up in a thin shell around mapped traces; the detached-* instruments narrow truth to pixels far from any visible trace to reduce it.
Fold-local candidates (this lane) never see the withheld components, so their numbers are not inflated by the privileged-catalogue bias; registry rasters' numbers are.
instrument_validity.consequence: No local instrument available to this repo can validate off-catalogue emission quality. Cross-family holdout ranking claims are withdrawn; only within-lane, fold-local comparisons are reported.
